ops-bot: RCA for the 3/15 serving capacity spike is published: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2123456789
ops-bot: TL;DR: transient autoscaler race + cold-cache desync -> short client-facing error spikes. Root cause analysis, immediate mitigations, and itemized owners are in the doc.
mike-h: thanks — can someone paste the owner/deadline summary here so it's easy to scan?
sara-l: owners are in the doc; quick summary below:
- elaine-p: implement abort-safe autoscaler lock (due 2026-04-01)
- ryan-s: add prefix-cache heartbeat metric and alert (due 2026-03-25)
- product-ops: prepare customer-facing SLA note and template (due 2026-03-20)
- eng-sre: add a regression smoke test to runtime CI (due 2026-03-22)
elaine-p: ack. I'll pair with @mike-h for integration tests; expect a draft PR by next Tue.
ryan-s: working on the metric now, low-risk change. will canary to staging tomorrow, ping me for metric names.
mike-h: can we add a lightweight CI script to reproduce the race? something that can run in the runtime-integration job — helps catch regressions.
elaine-p: yep. draft CI snippet I'll use: 
```bash
# simulate concurrent scale up to reproduce race condition
python tests/simulate_scale_race.py --clients 50 --duration 30\```
product-ops: noted for comms. I'll draft a short note for affected customers and the support playbook, will share before EOD.
mike-h: thanks — I'll own weekly check-ins until the main items are closed. please update the RCA action tracker (link in doc) with PRs/links. :white_check_mark: 
ops-bot: follow-up checkpoint meeting scheduled for 2026-03-25 11:00 UTC; calendar invite sent to participants.
